Subject: Your maritime salvage claim matter

Dear Ms. Saxena,

Thank you for meeting us on 03/10/2023 about your dispute with M/s Mehra Marine Ltd. As we understand it, the vessel is about to leave port.

Our advice is to arrest the vessel to secure the salvage claim. Please collect the salvage agreement and the logbook entries and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
